newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Incentive's Gambro acquires Hungary dialysis co.
newsitem.headline: Incentive's Gambro acquires Hungary dialysis co.

text.p: Swedish investor group Incentive on Thursday said its medical technology subsidiary, Gambro AB, had acquired the company International Dialysis Centers that has three clinics in Hungary.
Incentive said International Dialysis Centers, set up in 1993, operated clinics in the southern Hungarian cities of Szolnok, Szeged, and Karcag.
The clinics, formerly owned by Israel listed Elbit Medical Imaging Ltd, currently provide care to about 180 patients.
Incentive said in a statement that about 27,000 treatments were carried out in the clinics in 1996.
Currently there are about 3,100 dialysis patients in Hungary with 90 percent treated in private clinics.
